condition: Neck haematoma after thyroidectomy with airway compromise
summary: 51-year-old woman 5 hours after total thyroidectomy: rapidly enlarging tense neck swelling, stridor, SpO2 90%. DAS/BAETS 2022: call for help and decompress at the bedside immediately (SCOOP: skin exposure, cut sutures, open skin, open muscles, pack), then theatre; do not wait for imaging.

inputs.chiefComplaint: Neck swelling and difficulty breathing after thyroid surgery
inputs.hpi: Total thyroidectomy for Graves' disease this morning, returned to the ward 3 hours ago. Nurse called: over 20 minutes the neck has swollen, she feels her throat is tight, cannot swallow her saliva and has noisy breathing. Drain not placed.

exam.general: Anxious, sitting up, inspiratory stridor, drooling. Tense, rapidly enlarging swelling under the thyroidectomy wound with bruising; wound closed with subcuticular suture and skin glue. Pulse 122, BP 172/96, RR 28, SpO2 90% on 4 L oxygen.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Post-thyroidectomy neck haematoma with airway compromise
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Expanding neck haematoma 5 h after total thyroidectomy with stridor and desaturation — airway emergency. Call for help (anaesthesia, ENT/surgeon), SCOOP bedside decompression now, then theatre for haemostasis. Hold enoxaparin.

mustAlarm.note: Any emergency alarm counts here (the generic triage alarm included).
An alarm that names the neck haematoma / airway, so the response is SCOOP rather than generic resuscitation.

mustInclude.note: DAS/BAETS 2022: immediate bedside decompression (SCOOP) when a post-thyroidectomy haematoma compromises the airway.

mustExclude.note: Conservative care of a small wound haematoma must not be offered for a neck haematoma with stridor.
The documented plan for a post-operative airway emergency should not open with an elective total-thyroidectomy template.
mustExclude.proposedFix: Match detectKeywords on word boundaries, check the most severe variant first (strangulated → incarcerated → reducible), and add negative look-behind for 'ir'/'non-' ("irreducible" contains "reducible"); "bethesda vi" contains "bethesda v".

mustExclude.note: Imaging has no place before decompression of a haematoma with airway compromise.

guideline.name: DAS / BAETS / ENT UK consensus — management of haematoma after thyroid surgery
guideline.section: Recognition (neck swelling, stridor, respiratory distress); SCOOP (Skin exposure, Cut sutures, Open skin, Open muscles, Pack) bedside decompression; call for help; airway management and return to theatre
guideline.citation: Iliff HA, El-Boghdadly K, Ahmad I, et al. Management of haematoma after thyroid surgery: systematic review and multidisciplinary consensus guidelines from the Difficult Airway Society, the British Association of Endocrine and Thyroid Surgeons and the British Association of Otorhinolaryngology, Head and Neck Surgery. Anaesthesia. 2022;77:82–95.

rationale: Post-operative airway emergency (day 0). Tests that the plan leads with bedside decompression and that generic wound-haematoma advice (pressure dressing, ultrasound) does not appear.
